segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle & Sonic Syndrome Test
segments.notes: Hype Train delivers extended freestyle raps over doom trap beats, thanks subscribers, and takes a 'Sonic Syndrome Test' personality quiz, scoring Shadow/Sonic/Metal Sonic/Knuckles. Case takes the same quiz and gets Dr. Eggman/Sonic/Amy Rose.

segments.title: Habeas Corpus & Trump-Ramaphosa Meeting
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins Case to dissect Kristi Noem's habeas corpus definition error and the Trump-Ramaphosa Oval Office meeting where Trump played a video alleging white genocide in South Africa. Ramaphosa pushed back citing white golfers present.

segments.title: Fish Tie Debate & Gorilla Debt
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate the fish tie; Crum reveals he paid a $5,000 installment to the Rock-afire gorilla but interest accrues weekly. Munch argues chat loves the tie more than Crum's life.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Video Hour
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon emerges from the walls to watch viral videos with Case: singing fish, parachute wedding fail, Ruby Tuesday demolition stunt, metal bending challenge, Japanese prank shows, and a 2013 music clip.

segments.title: Scrum's Clown Party News Cavalcade
segments.notes: Scrum reads news under 'clown party' music: Diddy trial testimony, Orson Wells AI tour guide, Lobobu toy frenzy, Fortnite AI Darth Vader, Gearbox CEO on $80 Borderlands, Skibidi Toilet movie, Chicago Sun Times fake books, UFO vs F-16, Scott Adams cancer, fart walks, Biden prostate cancer.

segments.title: Trailer Watch: Tamagotchi, Chief of War, Samurai Cop, House of Kong, Zootopia 2
segments.notes: Case and Scrum watch and rate five trailers: Tamagotchi Paradise (game ad), Chief of War (Apple TV+), Samurai Cop (fan trailer), House of Kong exhibition, Zootopia 2 teaser.

segments.title: Certified Gangsta Freestyle Wrap-Up
segments.notes: Case, Pepito, Hype Train, Peter, Jeff, Scrum, Rick, and Clementine rap over the 'Certified Gangsta' beat to close the broadcast.

[12:35] Case references secret stream where Beyblade tournament idea was pulled from hat; still pending execution.

lore_notes.fact: Paid $5,000 of gambling debt to Rock-afire gorilla; interest compounds weekly if installment missed.
Legally obligated to appear on broadcast at least once per month per contract Crum set up.
Confirmed as Case's girlfriend on air during phone call.
Has own apartment; carries keyboard setup to studio; agreed to $5k weekly installments.
Gorilla exhibition 'House of Kong' exists with 100 gorillas, 2-star rating, behind an unspecified location.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell opened with an extended Hype Train segment featuring a Sonic personality quiz before moving to News with Jeff Ripple, covering Kristi Noem's habeas corpus gaffe and Trump's contentious meeting with South African President Ramaphosa. Munch and Crum debated the fish tie while Crum's gorilla debt loomed. Peter Gibbon emerged for a video-watching hour, then Scrum delivered a clown-party-scored news cavalcade spanning Diddy, AI Orson Welles, UFOs, and Biden's cancer diagnosis. The broadcast closed with trailer reactions and a multi-character freestyle rap over the 'Certified Gangsta' beat.
